scope: Explicit process-paired number source for positive KSAS QC/QI mass packets in the authorized same13 MP37 experiment.

source.native_process_behavior: The selected KSAS wrapper returns QC/QI mass tendencies and no corresponding NC/NI tendencies. Positive source packets receive an explicit number source before calculate_phy_tend applies the same mu-coordinate coupling.
source.observed_attribution: The closed diagnostic candidate found 346 positive KSAS QI source cells, zero negative QI source cells, and no KSAS QNI source. At the four zero-base QI/NI failures, aggregate QI source exactly equaled rqicuten and aggregate QNI source was zero. This is source attribution for that run, not scientific validation.

basis.coupling: Add N_source to scalar_tend(P_QNC/P_QNI) before calculate_phy_tend; native calculate_phy_tend then applies the same (c1*mu+c2) factor as other scalar tendencies.
basis.scope: Only the explicit positive KSAS process mass packet is converted. Existing PBL/other-process number tendencies remain independently additive; no aggregate residual is used.

QCLOUD.center_rule: geometric mean of declared mean-particle-mass bounds; equivalently PIDN/(sqrt(lambda_min*lambda_max))^d under the frozen QCLOUD source equations

limitations.negative_ksas_mass_sources: No negative KSAS QI source was observed in the attribution run. If a negative source occurs, pair its sink using the pre-source N/Q state or reject the process packet; do not silently omit or floor moments.
limitations.ledger: pr85_cumulus_source.raw records process Q rate, proposed N rate, the actual REAL32 scalar-tendency delta, timestep, cell, and applied source center (or pre-source N/Q for a sink). The ledger is not a conservation closure or observational PSD measurement.
